sections.label: h-craft
sections.html:
The craft

01 / 04
01The craft

The loom

Every Mangalagiri saree starts on a handloom. The weaver throws the shuttle by hand, thread by thread, over several days.

02The craft

The zari border

Borders are woven in with silver and gold zari. A crisp, clean border is the signature of Mangalagiri.

03The craft

Finished by hand

Embroidery, applique and fine work are added by hand once the weaving is done.

04The craft

Painted and printed

Kalamkari, Tanjore and hand-painted pieces carry stories from the region in colour.

See every collection
